about.title: About
about.name: Tlanextli is a Nahuatl word meaning radiance, light, clarity. I chose it because that's what I want my work to do: bring clarity. Code that's easy to understand, processes that are documented, and learning that's shared.
about.who: I'm Luis Ángel López, a developer based in Mexico. I'm into artificial intelligence and web development, and this site is how I build in public: every project and every lesson gets logged here.
